title: The command keeps working against the running app after a rebuild
notes: Retro 2026-11-28: 'this command is vX and the running Dashboard is vY — restart the app' appeared 16 times; the last land of a session could not release its pane until the app restarted. DASHBOARD_COMMAND and DASHBOARD_BOARD point into the installed build, which a rebuild replaces under the running app. Wanted: sessions the running app starts keep running the command files of that app's own version (for instance the app copies its command entry files to a per-version folder at launch and points the env vars there), so a rebuild changes nothing until the restart. Keep the version-mismatch refusal for whatever still mismatches. Design first: read how the env vars are set and the version check, and record the decision.
